verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents a dedicated machine limits page that links to a team quota/service limits section with an increase-request process. It also documents an approval request for high-end machines such as the H100, so both visible limits and a defined way to raise them are covered. missing for 10: the actual quota and limit values aren't quoted in the evidence, the increase workflow (turnaround, criteria) isn't detailed, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can see documented quotas and instance limits and raise them through a defined process

citations.quote: You can submit an [increase request](/products/paperspace/accounts-and-teams/#team-quota-service-limits) to remove this limit.
If you choose any high-end machines, such as NVIDIA H100, you need to request for approval to use them.
